title: Case 045: Kitchen Window and Patio Door Window Repair
overview: The tenant requested repairs relating to the kitchen window and patio door windows. The agency asked whether the landlord had requested the work; the tenant said it had not been requested by the landlord. The landlord then arranged for his own contractors to assess and quote for the windows, with the patio door glass noted as a possible future item. There were follow-ups while the visit and work were pending. The landlord ultimately confirmed the work was done, and the request was marked completed without payment. A later landlord email asked about a new appointment with tenants at a different address.
outcome: The landlord confirmed that the window work was completed. The request was closed as completed without payment.
